item.title: What are the different types of digital wallets?
item.description: Digital wallets can completely remove the need to carry cards and cash, but there's a lot more to them than just your usual Apple, Samsung and Google offerings.

item.title: Customizable split mechanical keyboard with integrated central touchpad goes on preorder for $160 — and this 3-pound slab is wireless and doesn't come with an infamous Copilot key
item.description: Vantex’s V1 is a split mechanical keyboard with a central touchpad and 60 keys, though its wireless version remains in development

item.title: Quote of the day by Apple co-founder Steve Jobs on touchscreens: "After an extended period of time, your arm wants to fall off"
item.description: Apple had resisted releasing a touchscreen laptop for years – despite the technology seeing plenty of success in the PC market

item.title: The pros and cons of using an eSIM over a physical SIM card
item.description: eSIMs are more convenient than physical SIM cards in many ways, but they aren't a 100 percent upgrade.

item.title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
item.description: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by their gorgeous, crystal-clear footage that seemed almost too good to be real. item.title: Samsung's archrival wants to spread 100 special CPUs in every SSD controller ahead of PCIe 8.0, High Bandwidth Flash onslaught
item.description: SK Hynix plans to deploy over 100 specialized processors in SSD controllers, reducing power consumption and chip area.
